newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine c. bank sells dollars at 28.40-traders.
newsitem.headline: Philippine c. bank sells dollars at 28.40-traders.

text.p: The Philippine central bank was selling dollars at 28.40 pesos in morning trading on Thursday, traders said.
A dealer said the central bank's intervention continued to be limited, selling $500,000 per transaction. It sold $2 million to $3 million.
The peso traded at 28.4/28.5 at mid-session, with volume light at $25 million.
"Banks are adoping a wait-and-see attitude whether the central bank would intervene more aggressively in the market," a trader said.
The central bank had said it would get a fresh supply of funds of about $700 million from the International Monetary Fund to shore up its reserves.
The peso had been weakening due to commercial demand for dollars while supply remained limited as exporters refrained from unloading their dollars.
